newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker market weak amid poor demand.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker market weak amid poor demand.

text.p: The Singapore bunker market was softer on Wednesday amid weak crude values and poor demand, traders said.
The 380-cst grade was quoted at $94/$97 per tonne, about $1-$2 per tonne lower than a day before, and the 180-cst grade was at $100/$103.
"Today I only got enquiries from old customers," said one supplier, adding that many shipowners were asking for too low prices.
MDO and gas oil were quoted around $188 and $198 respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (65 8703571)
